## Context / Problem
Three live Jira Cloud/S3 test modules contain oversized module docstrings. Their bytes were revalidated on `origin/main@0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e`.

## Approach
Condense only the three module docstrings named in Scope. Preserve every runtime string, constant, fixture value, decorator, assertion, and executable statement.

Compare immutable before/final blobs with `ast.parse(..., type_comments=True)`. Remove only the leading module docstring, normalize `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`, and require the remaining ASTs to match. A separate physical-line check preserves shebang/directive inventory exactly; this cohort currently has none.

## Scope
- `tests/external/live_jira_cloud_s3/_cloud_s3_support.py` module docstring — preserve the read-only Jira boundary, pytest bare-import constraint, and structural role of the mutator inventory.
- `tests/external/live_jira_cloud_s3/conftest.py` module docstring — preserve structural Jira-write prohibition, isolated throwaway S3 store, three opt-in layers, and teardown ownership.
- `tests/external/live_jira_cloud_s3/test_cloud_s3_rehearsal.py` module docstring — preserve the read-only guarantee and scenario responsibilities: dual-project mapping, real-volume inbound fetch, per-project scoping/preview, S3 round trip, unknown-project continuation, and non-vacuous mutation guard.

Consumers are pytest bare imports, fixture/autouse discovery, the external-integration workflow, and the suite README. No runtime docstring reader was found. Live Jira/S3 execution remains opt-in; AST equality is the semantic-preservation proof.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Exactly the three allowlisted module docstrings changed.
- [x] Each edited docstring remains nonempty and is shorter.
- [x] The normalized non-docstring AST is unchanged.
- [x] The directive and shebang inventory is unchanged.
- [x] The exact three-path and scoped-diff checks pass.
- [x] Scoped Ruff, format, comment-hygiene, lint, and typecheck checks pass.
- [x] The seven owned Jira Cloud/S3 scenarios collect successfully.
- [x] [non-codebase] The independent receipt has exactly three unique rows and every semantic, directive, and bloat verdict is PASS.
      provenance: environment=local read-only worktree; principal=/root/implement_core_test_comments/review_de77_final_clean; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=static-analysis — reviewed exact commit e6cc07a366bf and all three receipt rows
- [x] [non-codebase] Gerrit change 2855 has LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, zero unresolved comments, and MERGED status at revision fd2b3184ce3c27f87e50f1738679db76e790aa2c.
      provenance: environment=Gerrit change 2855; principal=Gerrit review and CI bots; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — both labels and merge status were read after submission

## Verification
Run the immutable AST/directive oracle, scoped Ruff and format checks, comment hygiene, seven-scenario collection, and `git diff --check`. Gerrit CI supplies the full suite under the operator comments-only waiver; the independent receipt is authoritative for prose quality.
